name: dt-app
description: The Dynatrace App Toolkit is a tool you can use from your command line to create, develop, and deploy apps on your Dynatrace environment.

breakingChanges.title: 1.0.0 Breaking Changes
breakingChanges.description:
- Remove the following command flags: `build --no-prod`, `build --prod`, `build --no-sdk-injection`, `create --oauth-client-id <id>`, `create --package-manager [name]`, `create --skip-repository-check`, `dev --no-sdk-injection`, `uninstall --global`.
- Remove the `server.open` configuration. This can be controlled by the `--open` flag.
- Remove build.\*.plugins configuration.
- Remove the `DEBUG` environment variable. Use the `--verbose` flag for debug output instead.
- Moves all sourceMap options to one centralized `build.sourceMap` option.
- Remove the `build --no-prod` and `build --prod` flags. The build mode can now be set inside the app.config file using the `build.mode` option.
- Remove `uninstall --global` flag.
- Remove `build.functions` configuration.
- Remove `deploy.build` configuration.
- Remove `distDir` configuration.
- Remove runtime simulator dependency.
- Drop native yarn support. It is still possible to skip the installation of dependencies via `--skip-install` flag and install them manually with yarn or another package manager.
- Remove `DT_APP_FORCE_TELEMETRY` environment variable support.
- Remove old icon property.
- Remove `file-watcher.include` and `file-watcher.ignore` configuration. It is no longer needed because the build is now following imports.
- Remove `additionalEntrypoint` configuration.
- Remove `DT_APP_SIGNING_PK` and `DT_APP_SIGNING_CERT` and the related legacy way of signing the artifacts.
- Remove `oauth2File` configuration.
- Remove `DT_APP_SERVERLESS_MAX_CONNECTIONS` environment variable.
- Remove the `create --oauth-client-id <id>` flag.
- Remove support for the `NODE_ENV='test'` option.
- Remove the `create --skip-repository-check` flag. If the build needs to be skipped, use the `--skip-build` flag instead.
- Remove `DT_APP_DISABLE_TELEMETRY`. If you need to disable telemetry, use the `DT_APP_DISABLE_TELEMETRY` environment variable.
- Remove `--no-embedded-templates` from create command.
- Remove `settingsPath` configuration.
- Remove `ui.entrypoint` and `ui.tsconfig` option.
